summary: Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed for /api/leads (all 6 valid form types persist correctly, invalid form_type -> 400, invalid email -> 422, sorted desc, filter). /api/newsletter subscribe returns 201 and is idempotent for duplicate email. Frontend: hero, nav Become-an-Agent -> lead form dialog submit -> success state and lead persisted, theme toggle switches dark mode, search bar submit executes, FAQ accordion expands (data-state=open), showcase next button clickable, footer newsletter subscribes and shows success toast. No functional console errors; only Radix a11y warnings about missing DialogTitle.

issues: Radix warning: DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for screen readers. Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle in LeadFormProvider dialog for a11y compliance.

action_items: (Minor a11y) Add a (optionally VisuallyHidden) DialogTitle to the Lead Form Dialog in /app/frontend/src/context/LeadFormProvider.jsx to eliminate Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/newsletter idempotent branch returns raw Mongo doc (still passes Lead model because _id is projected out); OK.
server.py: created_at stored as ISO string — sort works because ISO strings sort lexicographically; acceptable.
No pagination cursor on GET /api/leads; using limit only (default 200). Fine for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test leads/newsletter subscriptions were created with TEST_ prefix emails; no cleanup performed (acceptable per prefix convention).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all lead endpoints and newsletter idempotency; regenerate with pytest for regression.
